scope: Native Strata BF16 LowConfidence controller and complete-model state validation; not full HF model-logit parity

controller.scope:
Check production LowConfidence selection/penalties against pinned HF Torch.

Synthetic controller tests, including actual 248320-wide vocabulary logits.
This is separate from complete-checkpoint generation and state tests.
controller.confidence_oracle: FP64 mathematical softmax accuracy <=3e-7; native runtime uses compensated FP32 only. HF CUDA predicted IDs and transfer decisions must match exactly.
controller.cuda_note: CUDA FP32 reduction itself differs from FP64 by ~6e-6 on large-vocabulary high-confidence flat tails; preserve measured deltas rather than hiding them in a widened bound.
